x: Next, running together, Michael and Eastman, and after them, with brief gaps, the rest of the field with the two veterans, Dick Savage and George Still amongst them.
At the bell he had a huge lead with Eastman second, but round the back straight Allum, running finely, went into second place, but pursuit of the leader was hopeless.

Chorley ran well to finish 11th and Rollins and Eastman had a rare "dust up" down the straight, Rollins winning on the post. Dewberry, Duffett and Bayliss, with several others, thought that once round the course was enough and so were not included in the final reckoning.
